notes.title: Moon Watch Small Update 🦇
notes.content:
Hey, Time Weavers!

We’ve just released a small update for Moon Watch that focuses on addressing a handful of bugs and improving your overall gameplay experience.

Here’s the full changelog:

 Fixed all turret cards showing the default turret sprite in the passive effect list.
 Fixed Boss disappearing in loop mode.
 Fixed excessive logs being generated during boss fights.
 Fixed borderless and fullscreen options being swapped.
 Fixed resolution switching and resolution options saving in windowed mode.
 Fixed Sliver Bullet Card having the wrong sprite in events (e.g., trades).
 Fixed Kunai Thrown Unlock not being counted.
 Fixed Bladestorm Attack not getting bigger when you have Butcher's Knife relics.
 Fixed softlock when attempting to play cards after the player has already won the level.
 Fixed card and relic descriptions always saying "Banishes" in the Unlock UI.
 Fixed Trigger Finger relic count text being cut off when the player has more than 9 of this relic.


Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback helps us improve Moon Watch with every update, and we’re always paying close attention to your reports.

Let us know if you run into any more issues or have suggestions by sharing them on the forums or Discord.

notes.title: Moon Watch is Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey, Time Weavers!

It feels surreal to finally say this: Moon Watch is now live in Early Access! 🎉

This moment wouldn’t have been possible without your support. Whether you’ve been following us since our Backpack Hero days or just discovered Moon Watch, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for believing in our little experimental game!

Creating Moon Watch has been an exciting (and sometimes nerve-wracking!) journey. Combining the chaos of bullet hells with the strategy of deckbuilding was a challenge we poured our hearts into, and we’re so excited to finally share it with you.

What’s in Early Access? 🧛
Right now, the Early Access version includes:

 Three unique playable characters with specialized playstyles and decks
 A variety of challenges, cards, and relics to experiment with
 Our first iteration of a complete gameplay loop

But this is just the beginning!

The Roadmap 🗺️
Early Access is a chance for us to keep building Moon Watch alongside you. We have a lot planned, and your feedback will shape what comes next. Here's a sneak peek at our roadmap:

 New Characters: More playstyles to master
 Additional Cards & Relics: Expanding your options for deckbuilding and combos
 More Enemies: New challenges to overcome
 More Rooms & Events: Expanding the variety of encounters to keep every run fresh.
 Achievements: A way to showcase your milestones and progress
 Performance Updates: Continued improvements to ensure smooth gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182028/9240d68f90a447b0bb490c39739f503413a3c999.png

Share Your Thoughts 🤔
We’re incredibly eager to hear your feedback. Whether it’s about a specific mechanic, balancing suggestions, or just something you love (or hate!), it all helps us make Moon Watch the best it can be. Drop your thoughts in the Steam forums, join our Discord, or leave a review.

Thank You ❤️
Launching a game, especially one that’s a bit unconventional like Moon Watch, is always a leap of faith. But knowing we have such an incredible community makes it all worth it. Thank you for giving us the chance to keep creating!

We can’t wait to see how you use time to master the chaos 🦇

— Jas, Binary and Gangs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182028/0ee38bfdf2497e05bf9fc13270dabc2663840530.gif

notes.title: Early Access Launch Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey, Time Weavers!

We’re beyond excited to share the news! Moon Watch is launching in Early Access on December 4th!
This journey wouldn’t have been possible without you. Your feedback and support have kept us going every step of the way. We’re incredibly grateful - thank you for making this possible! ❤️

Why Early Access?
We want to make the best game we can! Capturing the intensity of survivors-like action while blending it with the depth of turn-based deckbuilding takes careful balancing. Early Access gives us the chance to bring in new players, hear your thoughts, and fine-tune the game to make it even better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182028/87130b1c79aff6c865ce88d1d3ebb5e4555b35fb.gif
Here’s What You Can Expect:
🌙 3 Playable Characters
🙏 Lucia the Nun
Your go-to starter character! She uses garlic to control space and projectiles to attack enemies. Straightforward and dependable.
🥷 Nina the Ninja
A melee queen! Nina thrives in close combat with dashes to evade enemies and powerful sword slashes. She also has a “curse” ability to weaken foes, making her a great pick for those who love risk and reward.
⚙️ Encio the Engineer
A creative powerhouse. Encio uses pinball ability to move around the level, relies on electricity and turrets as offense. Also has a “charm” ability that he can use to turn enemies against each other.

🌌 Features:
📖 3 full acts with over 50 randomly selected stages
🧛 3 main bosses
🎮 3 main game modes: Classic, Horde, and Wave
🦇 23 enemies and mini-bosses with unique abilities
🃏 80 cards
💎 43 relics
And Beyond!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182028/c42b57a4e929ae3f3352423b1e3e7217da6e07a0.gif

Early Access is just the beginning. We’ll continue working on Moon Watch to refine and expand it. Your feedback will be vital in shaping its future and helping us deliver the best experience possible.
Mark your calendars, wishlist the game if you haven’t already, and get ready to join us on December 4th.
Thanks for being part of this incredible journey. See you soon in the world of Moon Watch! 

— Jas, BinaryCounter and Gangs

notes.title: Big Demo Update #2: Endless Mode
notes.content:
Thank you all for a wonderful Next Fest!

Today we have our second major demo update – take on two endless challenge modes or beat the demo, and take your build into a tougher loop. 🦇 Each loop gets harder and there's no limit to how far things will escalate... welcome to infinite infinity!

What’s new? Not just one, but three types of Endless Mode!

🔄 Loop Mode: After completing the game, dive into Loop Mode, where you’ll continuously replay Acts 1 and 2. The deeper you go, the tougher the challenge. How many can you survive?

🌊 Wave Mode: Once unlocked, select Wave Mode from the main menu and face endless waves of Ghouls. Each wave gets stronger, pushing your skills to the limit as you fend off an increasing onslaught of ghastly foes.

🧟 Horde Mode: For the ultimate endurance test, Horde Mode never stops. Like Wave Mode, it’s selectable from the main menu after unlocking. The enemies keep coming with no reprieve—you’ll need sharp weapons and even sharper wits. Can you hold back the unrelenting horde?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182028/d6fea430841a0ed79ee7cdf05d847dd91c530d5e.png

Gear up, plan your tactics, and fight to survive! Play the Demo and let us know what you think about the new content 🧛

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126870/Moon_Watch_Demo/

notes.title: Welcome to Moon Watch!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We're Team Backpack, we made Backpack Hero, and this is our next game!

Moon Watch is a Time-Stop Horde Survival Roguelike! Build your deck, command time itself, devastate the horde. We think fans of Backpack Hero will really enjoy the deck-building synergies of this new game! 

Check out the first demo preview with Retromation.

[previewyoutube=1mEoBuOddOQ;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]Inspired by Survivors-likes, Deckbuilders, and a good dose of "time is movement" – Rock, Paper, Shotgun just called it a "sadistic reversal of the premise".

⏱️ Time is movement – think strategically, dodge gingerly, laugh the horde in its face.

🧄 Deckbuilding is power – garlic, golden garlic, lightning, turrets, teleports, devastating synergies.

🦇 Survival is your goal  – outlast hordes of space-undead, slay mighty vampire bosses.


Try the Demo
Big Update Out Now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126870/Moon_Watch_Living_Demo/

We’re curious to see if you like it and what we can improve, so we’re inviting everyone to play during development – expect updates, new features, content, and mad experiments.

If you joined the earlier demo playtest, good news: now there’s double.

The first Big Demo Update is out on Steam, featuring:

⌛ Acts One and Two – beat the first boss, then the second BOSSER BOSS.
🌟 New run rewards – win or lose, earn new cards, challenge runs, funky starter decks.
 🎲 Randomized runs – now with more than one permutation, expect the unexpected!
📈 More everything – abilities, powers, game-twisting relics, and silly synergies.
🔥 Better many things – tons of fixes and improvements, playtesting is good investing ✨

See the full patch notes for what's new!

Give it a shot and join us on Discord – we'd love to hear your feedback.
